name: fidelity
purpose: Does a small piece of the Pattern 1 matrix fold like a large one? Two arms (seed_stitch 0.2 and 0) at tiles 1 and 2, yarn only, no shell. Tiles 3 is the separate spec fidelity_large.

estimate.basis: 2.9e-4 s per vertex per sub-round x 80 sub-rounds (outer 20 x 4); 42.1 vertices per stitch (measured by building: 13481 at tiles 1, 53953 at tiles 2). The old tiles-3 yarn-only jobs (webui/results/20261031-191813, entries 8 and 10: same total iterations) ran 23% longer than this formula, so the corrected figure is shown too.
estimate.note: Extrapolated beyond the timing ladder (largest 6048 vertices); startup adds about 5 to 10 s per run.

sourced: relax.E 3700 MPa: Kharkova et al. 2011 (webui/main.py CONFIG)
relax.tension 10 cN: lowest of the 10/20/30 cN cotton values in the Mechanika study cited in webui/main.py
unsourced: relax.mu 0.49, relax.ei 0.25, relax.stretch_law 0.01:80,0.03:200,0.06:330, relax.length_ratio 0.95, relax.straight 0.05, relax.curl 0.01 (copied from the last real job, webui/results/20261031-191813/job_request.json; provenance not recorded; CLAUDE.md says the yarn EA/EI/stretch curve is still to be measured)
relax.kc_ratio 30 (webui default, numerical choice tested on one fabric)
seed_stitch 0.2 (chosen by K; magnitude has no source, 0 is the unseeded control arm)
thresholds.* (classification thresholds for the metrics, chosen by the author)
timeout_s 7200 (operational limit, about 4.7x the longest corrected estimate)
